grouping: Alternate builds from one source kit share one split; variants never cross splits.

qualification.selection: Deterministic connected original-source subassembly and exposed registered sites. Reject only for geometric qualification or absent executable nontrivial component, never observed model or policy performance.

heldoutSampling.starts: Seeded valid physical states from the certified component; no ranking by heuristic gap, solver expansions, or policy success.
heldoutSampling.workOrders: Seeded subsets of inspectable registered sites, chosen before control runs.
heldoutSampling.targets: Full assembly and seeded supported partial targets.
heldoutSampling.admission: Exact reachability and valid protocol budgets; retain easy cases and publish exclusions.
heldoutSampling.difficulty: Report operation length and mechanism independently of solver-conditioned difficulty.

scope: New source split for this release. Public after release; not a permanently secret benchmark.
